nota: Risk blocks of the Lab (editable). Crypto tickers can be written with or without the -USD suffix. A ticker that is not in any block falls into 'resto'; if it is in several, the first one wins. 'indice_proxy' is the yfinance ETF/index used when an asset did not exist during a scenario window. 'bandas.referencia_pct' is the weight of the block on the reference date (descriptive mode): an alert means the block drifted away from that reference, not that it is wrong. The band is computed with 'regla_banda'. Demo values: the references are the weights of the fictional portfolio on the last day of the price fixture.

regla_banda.descripcion: Band = reference +/- the smaller of 'absoluta_pp' points and 'relativa' x reference.

tope_posicion.nota: VTI is a deliberate exception (broad-market core holding): it is shown with the 'excepcion' label, without warning or alert.
